lines.text: Good evening, city. This is Velvet, coming to you from the Rooftop. String lights on, skyline up, and After Hours is open.
You found the Night Rooftop. Twenty floors up, the whole city watching. I'm Velvet, and nobody sleeps tonight.
Welcome to After Hours. I'm Velvet. Up here we keep it low, keep it smooth, and let the skyline judge.
Hey, night people. The elevator's slow again, so if you took the stairs, you earned your seat. Velvet, live from the Rooftop.
Fire escape crew, I see you. Let the whole block hear it.
Tower across the street, flash those window lights if you're watching.
This one goes out to Nico, driving the night bus. Honk if you're listening.
Folks by the water tower... louder. The city can't hear you.
Request line's open. Tonight the only request is noise.
Jules by the planters, you brought the whole building up here. Respect.
Little breeze up here tonight. That's the city exhaling. It's been waiting all week for this.
Dumpling cart downstairs stays open till the last shot. Priorities. I respect a cart with priorities.
A thermos of tea showed up by my mic stand. It's mine now. Rooftop law.
Somebody hung every one of these string lights by hand. One still blinks. We call it the critic.
The tower across the street used to complain about the noise. Now they hold up score cards.
Pigeons on the ledge again. Front row every night, and they never buy a ticket.
Radio rule number one: never talk over a good play. Rule number two: there's always a good play.
Hear that rumble? That's the last train of the night. It always slows down to watch.
Oh, there's the opening note.
Warming up nice and slow. Like a record.
Easy now... I see that groove.
Now the whole skyline's paying attention.
Turn the string lights up. It's happening.
Hear that? This roof is yours now.
Okay, now I'm loud. Unstoppable!
Can't miss. Won't miss. The city's glowing.
Somebody call downstairs. The whole building's shaking!
Unreal. Nobody touch the dial.
Getting chilly. Grab a jacket, then a bucket.
Slow song right now. Change the record.
Deep breath. The night is long.
That's the show. The whole skyline saw it, and the skyline doesn't forget. Goodnight, champ.
You came up to the Rooftop and took the whole night. After Hours belongs to you.
Take a bow, headliner. That was the best set this roof has heard all year.
I don't raise my voice. But for you? Winner! Now go home and dream about it.
Not your night. This roof stays open, and the city stays up late. Come back.
The elevator's slow. Use the ride down to plan the rematch.
Every great set has a rough night. Tomorrow, same roof, same lights. I'll save your spot.
Head up. The skyline saw the heart in that. Request line's open for the rematch.
